title: Spectral asymptotics of sub-Riemannian Laplacians on compact Heisenberg manifolds
summary: Let \(N_M(λ)\) be the spectral counting function of the sub-Laplacian on the compact Heisenberg manifold \(M=Γ\backslash\mathbb H_d\), where $Γ$ is a lattice subgroup of the Heisenberg group $\mathbb H_d$. In 2016, Strichartz \cite[\textit{J. Geom. Anal.}]{Str16} proved the Weyl law with remainder \(R_M(λ)=N_M(λ)-A_d\operatorname{vol}(M)λ^{d+1} = O_M(λ^d\logλ)\), and conjectured the optimal remainder to be \(O_M(λ^d)\).
